title: Copper Key
caption: First of the three. Found behind the Tomb of Horrors after a perfect game of Joust.

title: Jade Key
caption: Second of the three. The shard that followed was hidden in a text adventure.

title: The Quarter
caption: Awarded by the machine itself for a perfect Pac-Man game. Worth one extra life.

title: Anorak's Almanac
caption: Halliday's notebook of obsessions, read by every gunter until the pages fell apart.

title: OASIS visor
caption: Worn until the foam went flat. The haptic gloves went first.
